canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Fenon Ulenar: 21-year-old man, 166 cm (medium), soft rounded construction with an evident middle and gentle limb contours, skin value band-4-medium. Face: wide triangular face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: torso angles three-quarter while both arms hang in deliberate asymmetric ease. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.
